assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create an original reusable Lunar New Year design component for community event and family entertainment designer, intended for family reunion social post and tabletop game night invitation. 
Subject: Arrange six anonymous mahjong tile backs, showing only plain smooth ivory thickness and muted jade green unmarked rear panels on a dark jade felt tabletop edge. Each tile is physically consistent in size and rectangular proportion, with faint corner rounding and credible stack height. No tile faces, Chinese characters, numbers, cartoon icons, playing cards, dice, money or gambling interface.

Light and finish: Even top-left softbox, subtle individual tile contact shadows, clean inviting community rather than gambling atmosphere. 
Constraints: One flat raster component with practical copy space where appropriate. The buyer adds all typography and brands. No letters, logos, watermarks, protected artworks, fake labels, simulated alpha, or unverified vector and seamless-tiling claims.

assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create an original reusable Lunar New Year design component for retail gifting and paper-bag packaging designer, intended for New Year limited-edition packaging preview and festive online retail banner. 
Subject: Feature one thick vermilion paper gift sack with believable folded side gusset, broad flat blank front, simple die-cut concealed handle and a single unprinted ivory card partially inserted at the open top. Avoid envelope-flap geometry, red packets, gold coin ornaments, text, product logos, package contents or gift wrapping clutter. 
Composition: Single 16:9 frame. Horizontal 16:9 studio flat lay with the bag occupying the right half but not clipping its folds; left half stays even warm ivory for independent promotional headlines. The blank front must be sufficiently planar for a buyer to composite a brand identity.

assets.theme: White Porcelain Gaiwan Lid and Amber Tea Halo on Pearl Card
assets.palette: porcelain white, pale amber, soft jade, paper pearl
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create an original reusable Lunar New Year design component for tea boutique seasonal gifting designer, intended for Lunar New Year tea gift launch banner and year-round premium tea brochure. 
Subject: Place the clean lid and shallow porcelain saucer of a generic white glazed gaiwan, viewed from above and slightly angled, on one pearl-ivory unprinted sheet. A small amount of amber tea reflection is visible only inside the lid rim as a restrained warm optical accent. Show believable glazed ceramic lip thickness and natural pale highlights. No full tea table, tea leaves, poured liquid stream, tea bags, red envelope or invented decorative characters. 
Composition: Single 16:9 frame. Horizontal 16:9 with the two small porcelain components arranged at the far lower-right, leaving the majority of left and upper center as a clean pearl field for typography. Keep layout visually spacious and compatible with cropping into premium product announcements. 
Art style: Elegant Editorial Tea Product Still Life. Traditional restrained editorial tea still life with clean physical ceramic surfaces, correct scale, calm premium finish and meaningful negative space. 
Light and finish: Quiet diffuse morning light, minimal warm-amber specular reflection, soft soft-edged contact shadows and muted tone. 
Constraints: One flat raster component with practical copy space where appropriate. The buyer adds all typography and brands. No letters, logos, watermarks, protected artworks, fake labels, simulated alpha, or unverified vector and seamless-tiling claims.
